---
title: "01_load_dataset"
format: html
---

Load tidyverse package

```{r}
#| echo: True
#| eval: False 
library(tidyverse)
```

Retrieve and load the dataset

```{r}
#| echo: True
#| eval: False

raw_dir <- "../data/_raw"
data_file <- "GSE162746_Raw_counts_collected.csv.gz"
data_path <- file.path(raw_dir, data_file)

data_loc <- "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE162nnn/GSE162746/suppl/"

# Create directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(raw_dir)) {
  dir.create(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Download only if the file doesn't exist
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  download.file(
    url = str_c(data_loc, data_file),
    destfile = data_path,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

# Import raw dataset
raw_data <- read_delim(
  data_path,
  delim = ";",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)
```

Save raw data

```{r}
write_csv(raw_data, "../data/raw_data.csv")
```
```{r}
head(raw_data)
```
